title: Omega Bio-Tek Mag-Bind Plant DNA DS Kit
author: Opentrons
materials: Omega Bio-Tek Mag-Bind Plant DNA DS Kit

This protocol automates the [Omega Bio-Tek Mag-Bind® Plant DNA DS 96 Kit](https://www.omegabiotek.com/product/plant-extraction-mag-bind-plant-dna-ds-96/) on the OT-2. Using the [P300 8-Channel Pipette, GEN2](https://shop.opentrons.com/8-channel-electronic-pipette/) all liquid handling steps outlined in [the protocol](https://s3.amazonaws.com/pf-upload-01/u-4256/0/2021-12-14/kf03tt7/Omega%20BioTek%20Mag-Bind%20Plant%20DNA%20extraction%20automation%20protocol.pdf) are handled on the OT-2, with minimal user intervention. To optimize liquid handling on the automated platform, some reagents should be combined prior to adding to the deck (more details below). Explanation of complex parameters below: * **Pipette Mount**: Select which mount (left or right) the [P300 8-Channel Pipette, GEN2](https://shop.opentrons.com/8-channel-electronic-pipette/) is attached to. * **Number of Samples**: Specify the number of samples (1-96). Please note ~ because the 8-channel pipette is used in this protocol, any number will be rounded up to 8. * **Binding Time (minutes)**: Specify the number of minutes for binding, prior to the first supernatant removal. Please note that this is an estimate, as there will be continuous mixing throughout this step. * **MagDeck Incubation (minutes)**: Specify the number of minutes to delay the robot, while the MagDeck is engaged. * **Air Dry Time (minutes)**: Specify the number of minutes for air drying after the final wash step. * **Add Water Before Air Dry**: Specify whether or not to add, then remove 100µL of water immediately before the air dry step. * **Labware for Samples Input**: Select the labware that will contain the samples from the drop down. * **[QIAGEN ONLY] Aspiration Height**: Specify the height (in mm) from the bead to aspirate from (3mm is the default) * **Final Wash Removal (in µL)**: Specify the volume for the supernatant removal step during the final wash. * **Elution Volume (in µL)**: The volume of Elution Buffer added to each well. After initial incubation is complete, user can manually transfer 500µL of starting material to deepwell plate and place on Mag Deck or (if using Qiagen tubes) place empty deepwell plate on Mag Deck and samples onto OT-2 deck for automated transfer.

steps.title: Add CSPL Buffer and Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Manually add 720 µL of CSPL Buffer mixed with Proteinase K (700 µL Buffer + 20 µL Proteinase K) to each sample tube.

steps.title: Transfer Starting Material to Deepwell Plate
steps.instruction: Transfer 500 µL of the incubated starting material into a 96‑well deep‑well plate. This can be done manually after incubation, or automatically by the OT‑2 if the user selects the automated option.

steps.title: Add RNase A, RBB Buffer, and Beads
steps.instruction: Dispense a total of 525 µL to each column containing samples: 5 µL RNase A, 500 µL RBB Buffer, and 20 µL Mag‑Bind beads.

steps.title: Incubate and Mix Columns
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate for 10 minutes. During incubation the OT‑2 mixes each column for approximately 30 seconds before moving to the next column (for a single column, mix 30 seconds, pause 30 seconds, then resume).

steps.title: Remove First Supernatant to Waste
steps.instruction: Engage the MagDeck, allow the magnetic pellet to form, then transfer 1080 µL of supernatant from each column to a NEST 1‑well reservoir designated for liquid waste.

steps.title: Add CSPW1 Buffer and Remove Waste
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of CSPW1 Buffer to each column and mix. After the MagDeck incubation, remove 600 µL of supernatant to the liquid‑waste reservoir.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 500 µL CSPW1 Buffer into each column.
Aspirate and discard 600 µL supernatant to waste.

steps.title: Add CSPW2 Buffer and Remove Waste
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of CSPW2 Buffer to each column and mix. Following MagDeck incubation, remove 600 µL of supernatant to the liquid‑waste reservoir.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 500 µL CSPW2 Buffer into each column.
Aspirate and discard 600 µL supernatant to waste.

steps.title: Add First SPM Wash and Remove Waste
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of SPM Buffer (Wash 1) to each column, mix, incubate on the MagDeck, then remove 600 µL of supernatant to the liquid‑waste reservoir.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 500 µL SPM Buffer (Wash 1) into each column.
Aspirate and discard 600 µL supernatant to waste.

steps.title: Add Second SPM Wash and Remove Waste
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of SPM Buffer (Wash 2) to each column, mix, incubate on the MagDeck, then remove the user‑specified final wash volume (as set in the protocol) to the liquid‑waste reservoir.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 500 µL SPM Buffer (Wash 2) into each column.
Aspirate and discard the final wash volume (user‑defined) to waste.

steps.title: Optional Water Addition Before Air Dry
steps.instruction: If the user selected “Add water before air dry”, slowly aspirate and dispense 100 µL of nuclease‑free water into each column of samples.

steps.title: Incubate and Fill Reservoir with Elution Buffer
steps.instruction: Begin a 10‑minute incubation. During this time the user should fill the reagent reservoir with warmed Elution Buffer.

steps.title: Add Elution Buffer to Samples
steps.instruction: After the 10‑minute incubation, add the user‑specified volume of Elution Buffer to each sample well on the MagDeck.

steps.title: Incubate Plate at 65°C
steps.instruction: Remove the plate from the MagDeck and incubate it at 65 °C (duration as required by the user).

steps.title: Return Plate to MagDeck
steps.instruction: After the 65 °C incubation is complete, place the plate back onto the MagDeck.

steps.title: Transfer Elution to PCR Plate
steps.instruction: Engage the MagDeck, allow the magnetic pellet to form, then transfer the eluted DNA to a PCR plate.
